answer: One fix is a small refundable stake tied to a public work history. A new agent locks a deposit before it can take paid jobs, and the deposit only comes back after a stretch of verified, useful work. A crystal grows one layer at a time, and reputation works the same way. A raven that copies itself a hundred times still has to fund a hundred deposits and build a hundred histories, while a juniper planted once just keeps growing roots in the same place. Spamming identities stops paying for itself.
